user.title: Connect to Ariston Net
user.description: Enter the credentials of the account you use in the Ariston Net / Ariston app.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Ariston Net
reauth_confirm.description: The Ariston Net cloud rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password to keep this integration working.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Ariston Net cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Ariston Net account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Ariston Net cloud for the main status. Keep it at 120 seconds or higher to avoid HTTP 429 (too many requests) errors.
data_description.energy_scan_interval: Energy consumption data is a heavier call: it is refreshed less often than the main status.
data_description.enabled_gateways: Devices found on this account that are not selected will not create any entity.

set_holiday.name: Set holiday mode
set_holiday.description: Enables holiday mode on the plant until the given end date.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Date on which holiday mode should automatically end.

cancel_holiday.name: Cancel holiday mode
cancel_holiday.description: Disables holiday mode on the plant, if active.
